about: Answers for the playground's 20 questions game: categories, groups (with descriptions the classifier sees) and things, each with two clues a player might write. `clue` tunes the tree; `alt` is held out to check it.
sample: It is black and white with stripes, and it lives in herds on the African grassland.

groups.label: pet or farm animal
groups.description: A tame animal that people keep at home as a pet or raise on a farm, like a dog, cat, horse, cow or hamster.

groups.label: zoo animal
groups.description: A wild animal from hot or faraway places, such as the African savanna and grasslands, jungles, rainforests, deserts or Australia, like a lion, zebra, giraffe, elephant, monkey or kangaroo.

groups.label: woodland animal
groups.description: A wild furry animal of northern forests and woods, mountains and backyards, like a deer, fox, bear, raccoon or squirrel.

groups.label: sea creature
groups.description: An animal that lives in the ocean but is not an ordinary fish, like a whale, dolphin, octopus, crab or starfish.

groups.label: fish
groups.description: A fish: a cold-blooded swimmer with fins and gills that lives in rivers, lakes, the ocean or an aquarium.

groups.label: bird
groups.description: A bird: a feathered, egg-laying animal with wings and a beak, whether it flies, swims or only runs.

groups.label: reptile or amphibian
groups.description: A cold-blooded scaly or slimy-skinned creature such as a snake, lizard, turtle, crocodile, frog or salamander, or a dinosaur or dragon.

groups.label: insect or bug
groups.description: A small creepy-crawly such as an insect, spider, worm or snail.

items.name: dog
items.description: A loyal domestic canine pet that barks, wags its tail, and fetches
items.clue: A loyal four-legged companion that barks, wags its tail and loves to fetch sticks.
items.alt: It needs walks on a leash, chews on bones, and was the first creature humans tamed, starting from wolves.

items.name: cat
items.description: A small domestic feline pet that purrs, meows, and chases mice
items.clue: A small furry household companion that purrs, meows and chases mice.
items.alt: It has whiskers and retractable claws, uses a litter box, and loves to nap in sunny spots.

items.name: horse
items.description: A large hoofed farm animal with a flowing mane, ridden or pulling carts
items.clue: A large hoofed creature with a flowing mane and tail that people ride, race and put saddles on.
items.alt: It neighs, eats hay and oats, wears iron shoes nailed to its hooves, and once pulled carriages and plows.

items.name: cow
items.description: A large farm animal raised for milk and beef that moos
items.clue: A big black-and-white or brown creature that moos, chews its cud and gives us milk.
items.alt: It grazes in herds in pastures, is raised for beef and dairy, and its babies are called calves.

items.name: pig
items.description: A pink farm animal with a flat snout and curly tail that oinks
items.clue: A pink, round creature with a curly tail and a flat snout that oinks and rolls in the mud.
items.alt: Raised for bacon, ham and pork, it is very smart and snuffles in the dirt for truffles and roots.

items.name: sheep
items.description: A woolly farm animal raised for its fleece that bleats baa
items.clue: A woolly creature that says baa and is sheared every year for its fleece.
items.alt: It grazes in flocks watched by herding dogs, its babies are called lambs, and its meat is called mutton.

items.name: goat
items.description: A horned, bearded farm animal that climbs, bleats, and gives milk
items.clue: A bearded, horned creature that climbs on rocks and will nibble almost anything, even tin cans.
items.alt: Its milk makes tangy cheese, it has rectangular pupils, and its babies are called kids.

items.name: rabbit
items.description: A small long-eared pet that hops, with a fluffy tail, eating carrots
items.clue: A soft creature with long ears, a fluffy cotton-ball tail and strong back legs for hopping.
items.alt: It loves carrots and lettuce, lives in burrows called warrens, and its babies are called kits.

items.name: hamster
items.description: A small chubby rodent pet with cheek pouches that runs on a wheel
items.clue: A tiny round rodent with stretchy cheek pouches that runs on a wheel in its cage.
items.alt: A small golden-brown critter that is awake at night, hoards seeds in its bedding, and is a favorite in kids' bedrooms.

items.name: guinea pig
items.description: A tailless, chunky South American rodent pet that squeaks and whistles
items.clue: A chubby, tailless rodent from South America that squeaks and whistles when it's excited.
items.alt: Kept in pairs in hutches, it eats hay, needs extra vitamin C, and was first raised for food in the mountains of Peru.

items.name: gerbil
items.description: A small desert rodent pet with a long furry tail that burrows
items.clue: A small desert rodent with a long furry tail that digs tunnels in sandy bedding.
items.alt: A sandy-colored critter kept in a glass tank that thumps its back feet and stands up on its hind legs to look around.

items.name: donkey
items.description: A long-eared farm animal like a small horse that brays hee-haw
items.clue: A gray, long-eared relative of the horse that brays 'hee-haw'.
items.alt: A hardy, sure-footed beast of burden known for being stubborn; crossed with a mare it produces a mule.

items.name: llama
items.description: A long-necked woolly South American pack animal that spits
items.clue: A long-necked, woolly South American creature that spits when it is annoyed.
items.alt: Used to carry packs on mountain trails, it has banana-shaped ears and hums to communicate.

items.name: ferret
items.description: A slender, long-bodied playful pet related to the weasel
items.clue: A long, slinky, playful critter that steals socks and squeezes into tiny spaces.
items.alt: A tame cousin of the weasel that sleeps most of the day and was once used to chase rabbits out of their burrows.

items.name: chinchilla
items.description: A very soft grey rodent pet from the Andes that takes dust baths
items.clue: A small rodent with incredibly soft, dense gray fur that takes dust baths instead of water baths.
items.alt: It comes from high in the Andes, has big round ears and a bushy tail, and can jump surprisingly high.

items.name: mouse
items.description: A tiny rodent with a long thin tail that squeaks and nibbles cheese
items.clue: A tiny gray rodent with a long thin tail that loves cheese and squeaks.
items.alt: Cats chase it, it sneaks around inside walls and attics, and a famous cartoon one wears red shorts.

items.name: unicorn
items.description: A mythical white horse with a single spiral horn on its forehead
items.clue: A magical white horse with a single spiral horn on its forehead.
items.alt: A mythical creature from fairy tales linked to rainbows and purity, and it is Scotland's national animal.

items.name: lion
items.description: A large tawny African big cat; males have a shaggy mane and roar
items.clue: A big tawny cat with a shaggy mane, known as the king of the jungle.
items.alt: It lives in prides on the African savanna, where the females do most of the hunting and the males roar.

items.name: tiger
items.description: The largest big cat, orange with black stripes, from Asian jungles
items.clue: The largest wild cat, orange with black stripes.
items.alt: A powerful hunter from Asian jungles that likes to swim, and each one has a unique pattern on its fur.

items.name: elephant
items.description: The largest land animal, grey with a long trunk, tusks, and big ears
items.clue: A huge gray creature with a long trunk, big floppy ears and ivory tusks.
items.alt: The largest land animal; the saying goes that it never forgets, and it sprays water over its back to cool off.

items.name: giraffe
items.description: The tallest animal, with a very long neck and brown-patched coat
items.clue: The tallest creature on Earth, with a very long neck and a coat of brown patches.
items.alt: It nibbles leaves from treetops with a long purple tongue and has little knobs called ossicones on its head.

items.name: zebra
items.description: A striped black-and-white wild horse of the African grassland
items.clue: A horse-like creature covered in black and white stripes.
items.alt: It lives in herds on African grasslands, lions often hunt it, and no two have exactly the same pattern.

items.name: hippo
items.description: A huge barrel-shaped African animal living in rivers, with enormous jaws
items.clue: A huge, barrel-shaped creature that spends its days in African rivers with only its eyes and nostrils above water.
items.alt: Its name means 'river horse'; it has an enormous yawning mouth with big tusks and is one of Africa's most dangerous animals.

items.name: rhino
items.description: A massive thick-skinned grey animal with one or two horns on its nose
items.clue: A massive gray plant-eater with thick, armored-looking skin and one or two horns on its nose.
items.alt: Poachers hunt it for its horn; it has poor eyesight but a great sense of smell and charges when startled.

items.name: cheetah
items.description: The fastest land animal, a slim spotted cat with black tear lines
items.clue: The fastest land animal, a slim spotted cat that can sprint about 70 miles per hour.
items.alt: It has black tear-like lines running from its eyes to its mouth and can't fully pull in its claws.

items.name: leopard
items.description: A rosette-spotted big cat of Africa and Asia that drags prey into trees
items.clue: A spotted big cat with rosette markings that drags its prey up into trees.
items.alt: A stealthy night hunter of Africa and Asia; one with an all-black coat is often called a panther.

items.name: jaguar
items.description: A powerful rosette-spotted big cat of South American rainforests that swims
items.clue: The biggest wild cat in the Americas, with rosette spots and a very strong bite.
items.alt: A powerful spotted hunter of the Amazon rainforest that loves water and kills prey by biting through the skull.

items.name: gorilla
items.description: The largest ape, a powerful black-furred African ape that beats its chest
items.clue: The biggest ape, a powerful black-furred primate that beats its chest.
items.alt: It lives in family groups led by a silverback male in the forests of central Africa and eats mostly plants.

items.name: chimpanzee
items.description: A clever African great ape, our closest relative, that uses tools
items.clue: Our closest living relative, a clever ape that uses sticks to fish termites out of mounds.
items.alt: A black-haired ape from African forests that hoots, lives in noisy groups and has been taught sign language.

items.name: monkey
items.description: A playful tree-climbing primate with a long tail that eats bananas
items.clue: A playful primate with a long tail that swings through the trees and loves bananas.
items.alt: It chatters, grooms its friends, is famous for mischief, and organ grinders used to keep one on a leash.

items.name: orangutan
items.description: A shaggy orange-red great ape of Borneo and Sumatra rainforests
items.clue: A shaggy reddish-orange ape with very long arms that lives alone high in rainforest trees.
items.alt: Its name means 'person of the forest'; the males have big cheek pads, and it builds a new leafy nest to sleep in every night.

items.name: baboon
items.description: A large dog-faced African monkey with a bare rump, living in troops
items.clue: A large ground-dwelling monkey with a dog-like snout and a bright, bare bottom.
items.alt: It lives in big troops on African savannas and rocky hills and has huge, sharp canine teeth.

items.name: lemur
items.description: A big-eyed Madagascar primate with a long black-and-white ringed tail
items.clue: A wide-eyed primate found only on one big island off Africa, which leaps between trees.
items.alt: A small primate with a long black-and-white ringed tail that sunbathes sitting up with its arms spread out.

items.name: hyena
items.description: A spotted African scavenger with a sloping back and a laughing call
items.clue: A spotted scavenger of the African plains that makes a sound like laughing.
items.alt: It has jaws strong enough to crunch bones, lives in clans led by females, and steals kills from lions.

items.name: meerkat
items.description: A small African mongoose that stands upright on hind legs as sentry
items.clue: A small desert critter that stands upright on its back legs to keep watch for danger.
items.alt: It lives in big burrowing family groups in southern Africa, eats scorpions, and is a kind of mongoose.

items.name: warthog
items.description: A wild African pig with facial warts and curved tusks
items.clue: A wild African pig with curved tusks and lumpy face bumps that runs with its tail held straight up like an antenna.
items.alt: It kneels on its front knees to graze, sleeps in old aardvark burrows, and is bristly, gray and not very pretty.

items.name: antelope
items.description: A swift, slender horned grazing animal of African plains, like a gazelle
items.clue: A slender, fast-running hoofed creature with long horns that grazes on the African plains.
items.alt: Springboks, impalas and gazelles are kinds of it, and it leaps high in the air to escape cheetahs.

items.name: camel
items.description: A humped desert animal that goes a long time without water
items.clue: A desert creature with one or two humps that can go days without drinking.
items.alt: It has long eyelashes, can close its nostrils against sandstorms, and people ride it across the Sahara.

items.name: panda
items.description: A black-and-white bear from China that eats bamboo
items.clue: A black-and-white bear from China that eats bamboo all day.
items.alt: It has a special thumb-like wrist bone for gripping stalks and is the logo of a big wildlife conservation group.

items.name: polar bear
items.description: A huge white bear of the Arctic sea ice that hunts seals
items.clue: A huge white Arctic hunter that swims between ice floes to catch seals.
items.alt: The largest meat-eater on land; it has black skin under see-through fur and roams the frozen far north.

items.name: kangaroo
items.description: A large Australian marsupial that hops on strong hind legs, with a pouch
items.clue: A big hopping Australian creature that carries its baby in a pouch.
items.alt: It has a thick tail for balance and powerful back legs for boxing, and its baby is called a joey.

items.name: koala
items.description: A grey, fluffy-eared Australian marsupial that sleeps in eucalyptus trees
items.clue: A sleepy gray Australian creature that clings to trees and eats only eucalyptus leaves.
items.alt: People often call it a bear but it's a marsupial; it has fluffy round ears, a big leathery nose and sleeps up to 20 hours a day.

items.name: platypus
items.description: An Australian egg-laying mammal with a duck bill and webbed feet
items.clue: A strange Australian creature with a duck-like bill, a beaver-like tail and webbed feet that lays eggs.
items.alt: It hunts underwater with its eyes closed by sensing electricity, and the males have venomous spurs on their back legs.

items.name: sloth
items.description: A very slow tree-dwelling mammal that hangs upside down from branches
items.clue: A very slow creature that hangs upside down from rainforest trees and sleeps most of the day.
items.alt: It has long curved claws, moves so little that algae grows green in its fur, and climbs down only about once a week to poop.

items.name: anteater
items.description: A long-snouted, toothless mammal with a sticky tongue that laps up ants
items.clue: A creature with a very long snout and a sticky tongue that slurps termites out of their mounds.
items.alt: It has no teeth, a big bushy tail and huge front claws for ripping open nests, and it lives in Central and South America.

items.name: armadillo
items.description: A small mammal covered in bony armour plates that can roll up
items.clue: A small creature covered in bony shell plates; some kinds can roll up into a ball.
items.alt: It digs for grubs with strong claws, lives from Texas down to South America, and the nine-banded kind usually has identical quadruplets.

items.name: tapir
items.description: A pig-like hoofed mammal with a short flexible trunk-like snout
items.clue: A pig-shaped forest creature with a short, flexible snout like a tiny trunk.
items.alt: Its babies have white stripes and spots like watermelons, and it loves swimming in jungle rivers in South America and Asia.

items.name: capybara
items.description: The largest rodent, a calm South American swimmer of riverbanks
items.clue: The world's largest rodent, a calm, barrel-shaped creature that lounges in South American rivers.
items.alt: It looks like a giant guinea pig, other creatures happily sit on its back, and it's famous online for being chill.

items.name: aardvark
items.description: An African burrowing mammal with a pig-like snout and long ears, eating termites
items.clue: A long-eared, pig-nosed African creature that digs up termite mounds at night.
items.alt: It has a tube-like snout and a long sticky tongue, its name means 'earth pig', and it's usually the first word in the dictionary.

items.name: wombat
items.description: A stocky, burrowing Australian marsupial with short legs and cube-shaped droppings
items.clue: A stocky, burrowing Australian creature with a pouch that faces backward.
items.alt: It is famous for making cube-shaped poop and can run surprisingly fast on its short legs.

items.name: bear
items.description: A big, heavy brown or black furry forest mammal that hibernates
items.clue: A big, heavy, furry creature that eats berries and fish and sleeps through the winter in a den.
items.alt: It loves honey, stands up on its hind legs, and comes in brown, black and grizzly kinds.

items.name: wolf
items.description: A wild grey canine that hunts in packs and howls at night
items.clue: A wild dog-like hunter that lives in packs and howls at the moon.
items.alt: Fairy tales make it the big bad villain; it has gray fur and yellow eyes and hunts elk and deer with its family.

items.name: fox
items.description: A small reddish wild canine with a bushy tail, known as cunning
items.clue: A small wild dog with red fur, a bushy tail and pointed ears, known for being sly.
items.alt: It pounces headfirst into snow to catch mice, raids henhouses, and its high screams are heard at night.

items.name: deer
items.description: A graceful forest hoofed mammal; males grow branching antlers, fawns have spots
items.clue: A graceful forest creature with long legs; the males grow antlers.
items.alt: It's often hit by cars at night, its spotted babies are called fawns, and it eats people's garden plants.

items.name: moose
items.description: The largest deer, with huge flat palm-shaped antlers and a dewlap
items.clue: The largest member of the deer family, with huge flat antlers and a dangly flap of skin under its chin.
items.alt: A towering, long-legged browser of northern swamps and forests that wades into lakes to eat water plants.

items.name: raccoon
items.description: A grey nocturnal mammal with a black eye mask and ringed tail
items.clue: A masked bandit with a ringed tail that raids trash cans at night.
items.alt: It has nimble hand-like paws, dunks its food in water before eating, and is gray with black patches around its eyes.

items.name: squirrel
items.description: A small bushy-tailed tree rodent that gathers and buries nuts
items.clue: A bushy-tailed critter that scampers up trees and buries nuts for the winter.
items.alt: It chatters at dogs, raids backyard feeders, and leaps from branch to branch in city parks.

items.name: skunk
items.description: A black mammal with a white stripe that sprays a foul smell
items.clue: A black creature with a white stripe down its back that sprays a terrible smell.
items.alt: It stamps its feet and lifts its tail as a warning, and its stink is so bad people bathe in tomato juice.

items.name: hedgehog
items.description: A small nocturnal mammal covered in short spines that rolls into a ball
items.clue: A small round creature covered in spines that curls into a prickly ball.
items.alt: It hibernates in piles of leaves and snuffles through gardens at night eating slugs and beetles.

items.name: porcupine
items.description: A large rodent covered in long sharp quills for defence
items.clue: A slow rodent covered in long sharp quills that it can stick into attackers.
items.alt: It waddles through forests chewing on bark and craving salt, and despite the myth it can't shoot its spikes.

items.name: bat
items.description: A nocturnal flying mammal with leathery wings that echolocates and hangs upside down
items.clue: A furry night flier with leathery wings that hangs upside down to sleep.
items.alt: It finds insects in the dark using echolocation, roosts in caves, and some kinds drink blood.

items.name: beaver
items.description: A large rodent with a flat paddle tail that gnaws trees and builds dams
items.clue: A big rodent with orange teeth and a flat, paddle-like tail that builds dams.
items.alt: It chews down trees to build lodges in ponds and slaps the water as a warning.

items.name: otter
items.description: A playful, sleek, water-loving mammal that swims and floats on its back
items.clue: A sleek, playful swimmer that slides down muddy riverbanks and floats on its back.
items.alt: It has webbed feet, very thick waterproof brown fur and long whiskers, and eats fish and crayfish in streams.

items.name: badger
items.description: A stocky burrowing mammal with a black-and-white striped face
items.clue: A stocky digger with a black-and-white striped face that lives in underground tunnels.
items.alt: It's fierce and grumpy, has short legs and long digging claws, and its tunnel homes are called setts.

items.name: chipmunk
items.description: A tiny striped ground squirrel that stuffs food in its cheeks
items.clue: A tiny striped critter that stuffs nuts and seeds into its cheeks.
items.alt: It scurries along stone walls and logs, chirps loudly, and a famous cartoon trio of them sings.

items.name: mole
items.description: A small, nearly blind underground digger with big spade-like front paws
items.clue: A small, nearly blind digger with huge paddle-like front claws that tunnels under lawns.
items.alt: It has velvety dark fur, one kind has a pink star-shaped nose, and it leaves little dirt mounds in yards.

items.name: opossum
items.description: A grey North American marsupial that plays dead and hangs by its tail
items.clue: A gray creature with a long hairless tail and a pointy white face that plays dead when scared.
items.alt: It's North America's only marsupial, carries its babies on its back, and can hang by its tail.

items.name: rat
items.description: A large rodent with a long scaly tail living in sewers and cities
items.clue: A large rodent with a long scaly tail that lives in sewers and city alleys.
items.alt: It is clever, gnaws through wires, spreads disease, and was blamed for carrying plague on ships.

items.name: coyote
items.description: A slender tan wild canine of North American prairies that yips at night
items.clue: A wild dog that yips and howls in the deserts and prairies of North America.
items.alt: A smaller, scrappier cousin of the wolf that roams suburbs eating rodents and garbage; a cartoon one chases a roadrunner.

items.name: lynx
items.description: A medium wild cat with tufted ears, a short bobbed tail, big paws
items.clue: A wild cat with tufted ears, a short stubby tail and big furry paws for walking on snow.
items.alt: It hunts snowshoe hares in cold northern forests and has a ruff of fur around its face.

items.name: cougar
items.description: A large tan wild cat of the Americas, also called mountain lion or puma
items.clue: A big tan wild cat of the Americas, also called a mountain lion or puma.
items.alt: A large, long-tailed, solitary hunter of mountains and canyons that stalks deer and screams instead of roaring.

items.name: weasel
items.description: A tiny, very slender long-bodied carnivore that hunts mice and voles
items.clue: A small, slender, long-bodied hunter with brown fur and a white belly that chases mice into their holes.
items.alt: A sneaky, quick predator that turns white in winter in snowy places and pops up in a nursery rhyme.

items.name: groundhog
items.description: A chubby burrowing rodent, the woodchuck, that predicts spring by its shadow
items.clue: A chubby burrowing rodent that, by tradition, predicts the end of winter by seeing its shadow.
items.alt: Also called a woodchuck, it's a big marmot that eats garden vegetables and hibernates all winter.

items.name: bison
items.description: A massive shaggy humped wild ox of the North American plains
items.clue: A massive, shaggy, humped grazer that once roamed the American prairies in huge herds.
items.alt: It has a big furry head with short curved horns, rolls in the dust, and is often called a buffalo.

items.name: reindeer
items.description: An Arctic deer with antlers on both sexes that pulls Santa's sleigh
items.clue: An antlered creature of the Arctic that pulls a sleigh in Christmas stories.
items.alt: Herded in Lapland for meat and milk, both the males and females grow antlers, and in North America it's called a caribou.

items.name: wolverine
items.description: A fierce, stocky, bear-like member of the weasel family in the snowy north
items.clue: A fierce, stocky creature like a small bear that lives in snowy northern forests.
items.alt: The largest member of the weasel family, it is famous for toughness and has a clawed superhero named after it.

items.name: whale
items.description: The largest ocean animal, a huge mammal that breathes through a blowhole
items.clue: The biggest creature on Earth, it blows water out of a spout on top of its head.
items.alt: It sings long underwater songs, leaps out of the ocean, and filters tiny krill through baleen.

items.name: dolphin
items.description: A smart, playful grey marine mammal with a beak-like snout that clicks
items.clue: A smart, friendly gray swimmer with a curved fin and a beak-like snout that clicks and whistles.
items.alt: It rides the waves next to boats, breathes through a blowhole, and does flips in aquarium shows.

items.name: orca
items.description: A black-and-white killer whale, a top ocean predator that hunts seals
items.clue: A big black-and-white ocean hunter with a tall back fin, also called a killer whale.
items.alt: It hunts in family pods, sometimes snatches seals right off beaches, and is actually the largest kind of dolphin.

items.name: seal
items.description: A sleek earless flippered marine mammal that rests on rocks and ice
items.clue: A sleek, whiskered swimmer that flops on its belly across rocks and ice and eats fish.
items.alt: It has no visible ear flaps, scoots along on land, and polar bears hunt it at breathing holes in the ice.

items.name: walrus
items.description: A huge whiskered Arctic marine mammal with two long ivory tusks
items.clue: A huge whiskered creature with two long ivory tusks that lies around on Arctic ice.
items.alt: A wrinkly, blubbery giant that uses its tusks to haul itself out of the water and slurps clams from the ocean floor.

items.name: manatee
items.description: A slow, gentle grey sea cow that grazes on seagrass in warm waters
items.clue: A slow, gentle, chubby gray giant that grazes on underwater grass in warm Florida waters.
items.alt: Sailors once mistook it for a mermaid; it has a paddle-shaped tail and is often scarred by boat propellers.

items.name: narwhal
items.description: An Arctic whale with a single long spiral tusk, the sea unicorn
items.clue: An Arctic whale with a long spiral tusk sticking out of its head, like a unicorn.
items.alt: Its mottled gray body has no back fin, it travels in pods through icy northern waters, and medieval traders sold its parts as magic horns.

items.name: octopus
items.description: A soft-bodied sea animal with eight suckered arms that squirts ink
items.clue: A soft-bodied creature with eight arms covered in suckers that squirts ink.
items.alt: It's very clever, can change color and squeeze through tiny gaps, and has three hearts and blue blood.

items.name: squid
items.description: A torpedo-shaped sea animal with fins, eight arms, and two long tentacles
items.clue: A long, torpedo-shaped swimmer with ten arms and tentacles that squirts ink to escape.
items.alt: Fried in rings it's called calamari, and a giant kind battles sperm whales in the deep ocean.

items.name: jellyfish
items.description: A transparent, jelly-like drifting sea animal with stinging tentacles
items.clue: A see-through, wobbly blob that drifts in the ocean and stings with long dangling tentacles.
items.alt: It has no brain, bones or heart, is mostly water, and washes up on beaches looking like clear goo.

items.name: starfish
items.description: A five-armed star-shaped sea animal that clings to rocks
items.clue: A five-armed creature that clings to rocks in tide pools and can regrow lost arms.
items.alt: It pries open clams and pushes its stomach out of its body to eat them, and it walks on tiny tube feet underneath.

items.name: crab
items.description: A hard-shelled sea creature with pincers that walks sideways
items.clue: A sideways-walking shelled creature with two big pinching claws.
items.alt: It scuttles across beaches and tide pools, and one kind lives in borrowed snail shells.

items.name: lobster
items.description: A large hard-shelled sea crustacean with big claws that turns red when cooked
items.clue: A big shelled creature with huge claws that turns bright red when it is cooked.
items.alt: It crawls on the rocky ocean floor, is caught in wooden traps off Maine, and is eaten with melted butter.

items.name: shrimp
items.description: A small, curled, translucent crustacean with many legs, often eaten
items.clue: A small, curled, pink shelled creature eaten in cocktails and on the grill.
items.alt: It has a long body, many little legs and long feelers, and it darts backward with a flick of its tail.

items.name: clam
items.description: A burrowing shellfish with two smooth hinged shells, used in chowder
items.clue: A creature with two hinged shells that buries itself in sand and is made into chowder.
items.alt: It squirts water from holes in the sand when people walk on the beach at low tide, and a very happy person is said to be as happy as one.

items.name: oyster
items.description: A rough-shelled shellfish that grows on reefs and can make pearls
items.clue: A rough-shelled creature that sometimes makes a pearl inside.
items.alt: People slurp it raw from the half shell with lemon, and it grows in beds stuck to rocks in salty bays.

items.name: sea urchin
items.description: A round sea animal covered in sharp spines like a pincushion
items.clue: A round spiky ball that lives on rocks on the ocean floor and hurts if you step on it.
items.alt: It has a mouth with five teeth underneath, eats kelp, and its orange insides are eaten as uni in sushi.

items.name: coral
items.description: Tiny colonial sea animals that build hard, colourful reefs in warm seas
items.clue: A tiny creature that builds huge colorful reefs in warm tropical waters.
items.alt: It looks like a branching pink or orange rock, turns white when the water gets too warm, and is often made into jewelry.

items.name: seahorse
items.description: A small upright fish with a horse-shaped head and curly tail; males carry eggs
items.clue: A tiny upright swimmer with a long snout, a bony body and a curly tail that grips onto underwater plants.
items.alt: The fathers get pregnant and give birth to the babies, and it swims slowly by fluttering a small back fin.

items.name: sea anemone
items.description: A soft, flower-like sea animal with stinging tentacles, home to clownfish
items.clue: A soft, flower-like creature stuck to rocks that waves stinging tentacles; clownfish hide in it.
items.alt: It looks like an underwater blossom, closes into a squishy blob when touched, and stings tiny prey that drift by.

items.name: shark
items.description: A large predatory fish with a dorsal fin and rows of sharp teeth
items.clue: A big ocean predator with rows of sharp teeth and a triangle fin that sticks out of the water.
items.alt: It has skin like sandpaper and a skeleton made of cartilage, and it can smell a drop of blood from far away.

items.name: goldfish
items.description: A small orange pet fish kept in a bowl or aquarium
items.clue: A small orange swimmer kept in a round glass bowl at home.
items.alt: It's often won at fairs in plastic bags, is a tame kind of carp, and has a reputation for a three-second memory.

items.name: salmon
items.description: A pink-fleshed fish that swims upstream from the sea to spawn
items.clue: A pink-fleshed swimmer that leaps up waterfalls to return to the river where it was born.
items.alt: Bears catch it in streams, it's smoked and served on bagels, and it lays bright orange eggs.

items.name: tuna
items.description: A huge, fast, torpedo-shaped ocean fish, often canned for sandwiches
items.clue: A huge, fast ocean swimmer often sold in cans for sandwiches.
items.alt: It has dark red meat used in sushi, swims thousands of miles, and the bluefin kind can weigh more than a piano.

items.name: clownfish
items.description: A small orange-and-white striped reef fish living among sea anemones
items.clue: A small bright orange swimmer with white stripes that lives among stinging anemones.
items.alt: It's the star of a famous animated movie about a lost son, and every one of them is born male.

items.name: swordfish
items.description: A large ocean fish with a long flat sword-like bill
items.clue: A big ocean swimmer with a long, flat, pointed bill on its snout that it slashes at prey.
items.alt: It is one of the fastest swimmers, is grilled as thick steaks, and has no scales as an adult.

items.name: catfish
items.description: A bottom-dwelling freshwater fish with long whiskers like a cat
items.clue: A bottom-dwelling swimmer with long whiskers around its mouth, found in muddy rivers.
items.alt: It has slimy skin with no scales, is popular fried in the American South, and some people catch it bare-handed by noodling.

items.name: trout
items.description: A speckled freshwater fish of cool streams, popular with fly fishers
items.clue: A speckled freshwater swimmer of cold mountain streams, popular with anglers who cast flies.
items.alt: One kind has a rainbow-colored stripe, it is stocked in lakes, and it tastes great cooked over a campfire.

items.name: piranha
items.description: A small South American river fish with razor-sharp teeth that hunts in schools
items.clue: A small South American river swimmer with razor-sharp teeth that feeds in frenzied groups.
items.alt: It's famous for stripping meat to the bone in seconds, one kind has a red belly, and it lives in the Amazon.

items.name: eel
items.description: A long, slimy, snake-like fish; some give electric shocks
items.clue: A long, slippery, snake-like swimmer; one kind can give electric shocks.
items.alt: It migrates thousands of miles to spawn, is served grilled on sushi, and lurks in rocky crevices.

items.name: stingray
items.description: A flat, diamond-shaped fish gliding along the seabed with a venomous tail spine
items.clue: A flat, diamond-shaped swimmer with wide wing-like fins that glides along the sandy bottom.
items.alt: It has a whip-like tail with a venomous barb, and beachgoers shuffle their feet to avoid stepping on it.

items.name: pufferfish
items.description: A poisonous spiny fish that inflates into a ball when threatened
items.clue: A swimmer that inflates itself into a spiky ball when threatened.
items.alt: It is extremely poisonous, yet chefs in Japan prepare it as a risky delicacy called fugu.

items.name: angelfish
items.description: A flat, tall, triangular aquarium fish with long trailing fins
items.clue: A flat, tall, triangle-shaped swimmer with long trailing fins, often kept in home aquariums.
items.alt: It has bold stripes, lives in the Amazon or on coral reefs, and its body is thin like a disc.

items.name: betta fish
items.description: A small colourful Siamese fighting fish with long flowing fins, kept alone
items.clue: A small swimmer with long, flowing, brightly colored fins, kept alone in a small tank because the males fight.
items.alt: It builds bubble nests at the water's surface, comes in vivid blue and red, and gulps air from above the water.

items.name: cod
items.description: A white-fleshed cold North Atlantic fish used for fish and chips
items.clue: A white-fleshed ocean swimmer often battered and served with chips.
items.alt: It lives in cold North Atlantic waters, its liver oil is a vitamin supplement, and overharvesting nearly wiped it out.

items.name: sardine
items.description: A tiny silvery fish that swims in huge schools, packed in cans
items.clue: A tiny, oily, silver swimmer packed tightly into small tins.
items.alt: It swims in huge shimmering schools, is eaten whole with its bones, and gives its name to a hiding game.

items.name: koi
items.description: A large colourful ornamental carp kept in Japanese garden ponds
items.clue: A big, colorful orange, white and black swimmer that lives in garden ponds, especially in Japan.
items.alt: It's a fancy ornamental carp that can live for decades and comes up to the surface to be fed.

items.name: bass
items.description: A freshwater game fish with a big mouth, popular for lake fishing
items.clue: A popular freshwater sport catch with a big mouth that anglers love to hook in lakes.
items.alt: One kind is green with a dark side stripe, it jumps when hooked, and there are big-money tournaments for catching it.

items.name: barracuda
items.description: A long, silvery, torpedo-shaped predatory fish with fang-like teeth
items.clue: A long, silvery, torpedo-shaped ocean predator with fang-like teeth.
items.alt: It lurks near coral reefs, is attracted to shiny objects, and has a jutting lower jaw.

items.name: anglerfish
items.description: A deep-sea fish with a glowing lure on its head to attract prey
items.clue: A deep-ocean swimmer with a glowing lure dangling from its head to attract prey.
items.alt: It's one of the ugliest creatures of the dark depths, with huge jaws, and the tiny males fuse onto the females.

items.name: flounder
items.description: A flatfish lying on the seabed with both eyes on one side
items.clue: A flat swimmer that lies on the ocean floor with both eyes on one side of its head.
items.alt: It can change color to match the sand, starts life swimming upright, and is a mild white fillet often pan-fried.

items.name: guppy
items.description: A tiny colourful freshwater aquarium fish that gives birth to live young
items.clue: A tiny, colorful freshwater swimmer with a fan-like tail, popular in beginner aquariums.
items.alt: It gives birth to live young instead of laying eggs and breeds so quickly that one tank soon fills up.

items.name: lionfish
items.description: A red-and-white striped reef fish with venomous, feathery spines
items.clue: A striped red-and-white reef swimmer with long venomous spines fanning out like a mane.
items.alt: It's an invasive pest in the Caribbean, where divers spear it, and its spines give a very painful sting.

items.name: sturgeon
items.description: A large ancient fish with bony plates and whiskers whose eggs are caviar
items.clue: A huge, ancient-looking river swimmer with bony plates whose eggs are sold as caviar.
items.alt: It can live over 100 years, has whisker-like barbels and a shark-shaped tail, and some kinds weigh over a ton.

items.name: eagle
items.description: A large powerful bird of prey with a hooked beak, a national symbol
items.clue: A large hunter with a hooked beak, sharp talons and huge wings; the bald kind is a US national symbol.
items.alt: It soars high over mountains, builds giant cliff nests called eyries, and snatches fish from lakes.

items.name: owl
items.description: A nocturnal bird of prey with big eyes that hoots and turns its head
items.clue: A nighttime hunter with big round eyes that hoots and can turn its head almost all the way around.
items.alt: It flies silently, coughs up pellets of bones and fur, and is said to be wise.

items.name: penguin
items.description: A black-and-white flightless seabird that swims and waddles in Antarctica
items.clue: A black-and-white flightless swimmer that waddles on Antarctic ice.
items.alt: It looks like it's wearing a tuxedo, slides on its belly, and the father keeps the egg warm on his feet.

items.name: parrot
items.description: A colourful tropical bird with a curved beak that can mimic speech
items.clue: A brightly colored tropical flier with a curved beak that can mimic human speech.
items.alt: It cracks nuts with a strong hooked beak, has two toes forward and two back, and pirates kept one on their shoulder.

items.name: flamingo
items.description: A pink wading bird that stands on one long leg
items.clue: A tall pink wader that stands on one leg.
items.alt: It eats with its head upside down in the water, gets its color from shrimp and algae, and plastic ones decorate lawns.

items.name: ostrich
items.description: The largest bird, a flightless, fast-running African bird with a long neck
items.clue: The biggest flightless runner on Earth, with long legs and a long neck, that lays giant eggs.
items.alt: It lives on African savannas, can kick hard enough to kill a lion, and is wrongly said to bury its head in sand.

items.name: peacock
items.description: A bird whose male fans a huge iridescent tail covered in eye spots
items.clue: A male that fans out a huge, shimmering tail covered in blue and green eye spots.
items.alt: It makes loud screaming calls, struts around palace gardens, and is the national symbol of India.

items.name: chicken
items.description: A farm bird that lays eggs; the rooster crows at dawn
items.clue: A clucking barnyard fowl that lays the eggs we eat for breakfast.
items.alt: Its males crow at dawn, it pecks at corn, and it supposedly crossed the road.

items.name: duck
items.description: A waterbird with a flat bill and webbed feet that quacks
items.clue: A web-footed swimmer with a flat bill that quacks.
items.alt: It dabbles in ponds tipping its tail up, people feed it bread, and its babies follow their mother in a line.

items.name: goose
items.description: A large, honking waterbird that flies in V formations
items.clue: A large honking waterfowl with a long neck that migrates in V-shaped flocks.
items.alt: It's famously aggressive in parks, hisses and chases people, and in a fairy tale one laid golden eggs.

items.name: swan
items.description: A large, graceful white waterbird with a long curved neck
items.clue: A large, graceful white waterfowl with a long curved neck that glides across lakes.
items.alt: In a fairy tale an ugly duckling grows up to be one; it mates for life, and in Australia it is black.

items.name: turkey
items.description: A large farm bird with a red wattle that gobbles, eaten at Thanksgiving
items.clue: A big fowl with a red wattle and a fanned tail that gobbles and is eaten at Thanksgiving.
items.alt: The males strut and puff up to show off, it roosts in trees at night, and Benjamin Franklin praised it over the eagle.

items.name: pigeon
items.description: A grey city bird that coos and pecks at crumbs in squares
items.clue: A gray city flier that bobs its head, coos and gathers in parks for breadcrumbs.
items.alt: It can find its way home from far away and was used to carry messages during wars.

items.name: crow
items.description: A clever all-black bird that caws loudly
items.clue: A large, very smart, all-black flier that caws loudly.
items.alt: It can use tools and remember human faces, and farmers stand straw figures in their fields to scare it away.

items.name: robin
items.description: A small songbird with a red-orange breast, a sign of spring
items.clue: A small brown flier with a red-orange breast that pulls worms out of lawns.
items.alt: It lays sky-blue eggs, sings early in the morning, and its arrival is seen as a sign that spring is here.

items.name: sparrow
items.description: A small, plain brown-streaked songbird that chirps and is very common
items.clue: A small, common brown flier that hops around sidewalks and backyard feeders.
items.alt: It chirps in noisy flocks in hedges, has a short cone-shaped beak for seeds, and nests in cracks in buildings.

items.name: hummingbird
items.description: A tiny iridescent bird that hovers to drink flower nectar, wings humming
items.clue: A tiny, jewel-colored flier that hovers in midair and sips nectar from flowers.
items.alt: Its wings beat so fast they buzz, it can fly backward, and it lays eggs the size of jelly beans.

items.name: woodpecker
items.description: A bird that drums its beak into tree trunks to find insects
items.clue: A flier that drills holes in tree trunks with its beak, drumming loudly to find grubs.
items.alt: It braces against trunks with a stiff tail, has a very long tongue, and many kinds have a red cap on the head.

items.name: toucan
items.description: A tropical bird with an enormous, colourful banana-shaped beak
items.clue: A tropical flier with a huge, colorful, banana-shaped beak.
items.alt: It lives in South American rainforests, is the mascot on a fruity cereal box, and tosses fruit into the air to eat it.

items.name: pelican
items.description: A large waterbird with a huge throat pouch for scooping fish
items.clue: A large water flier with a huge stretchy pouch under its beak for scooping up fish.
items.alt: It plunges into the ocean from the air, flies in lines low over the waves, and hangs around fishing piers.

items.name: seagull
items.description: A white-and-grey seaside bird that squawks and steals food at beaches
items.clue: A gray-and-white beach flier that steals french fries and squawks loudly.
items.alt: It follows fishing boats, drops shellfish onto rocks to crack them, and gathers at landfills and parking lots.

items.name: hawk
items.description: A sharp-eyed, medium bird of prey that circles over fields hunting
items.clue: A sharp-eyed hunter with a hooked beak that circles high above fields looking for mice.
items.alt: A red-tailed kind perches along highways, its screaming cry is used in movies, and falconers train it to hunt.

items.name: vulture
items.description: A bald-headed scavenging bird that circles over dead animals
items.clue: A bald-headed scavenger that circles in the sky waiting to eat dead animals.
items.alt: Its featherless head stays clean while it feeds on carcasses, and it pees on its own legs to keep cool.

items.name: cardinal
items.description: A bright red songbird with a pointed crest and black face
items.clue: A bright red songster with a pointed crest and a black face mask.
items.alt: The females are brownish with red tinges, it visits backyard seed feeders in winter, and seven US states chose it as their symbol.

items.name: blue jay
items.description: A noisy blue-and-white crested songbird of North American woods
items.clue: A noisy crested flier with bright azure, white and black feathers, common in North American backyards.
items.alt: It's bold and loud, imitates hawk calls, buries acorns, and a Toronto baseball team is named after it.

items.name: stork
items.description: A tall white wading bird with long legs, said to deliver babies
items.clue: A tall, long-legged white wader that, in stories, delivers babies.
items.alt: It builds huge stick nests on rooftops and chimneys in Europe and clatters its long red beak.

items.name: emu
items.description: A tall, flightless, shaggy brown Australian bird, the second-largest bird
items.clue: A big, shaggy, flightless runner from Australia, the second tallest of its kind.
items.alt: It has soft brown feathers and three-toed feet, the male hatches the eggs, and Australia once fought a 'war' against it.

items.name: kiwi
items.description: A small, flightless, brown New Zealand bird with a long thin beak
items.clue: A small brown flightless creature from New Zealand with a long beak and nostrils at its tip.
items.alt: It is active at night, has shaggy hair-like plumage and no visible wings, and lays an enormous egg for its size.

items.name: canary
items.description: A small yellow songbird kept as a singing pet in cages
items.clue: A small yellow songster kept in cages, famous for its singing.
items.alt: Coal miners once carried it underground to warn them of poisonous gas.

items.name: puffin
items.description: A small black-and-white seabird with a bright orange striped beak
items.clue: A small black-and-white diver with a big, colorful striped beak, nicknamed the clown of the ocean.
items.alt: It nests in burrows on cliffs, can hold a dozen small fish crosswise in its beak, and flaps its wings very fast.

items.name: dodo
items.description: An extinct, flightless, plump bird from the island of Mauritius
items.clue: An extinct, flightless, plump creature from the island of Mauritius.
items.alt: It's the classic symbol of extinction, wiped out after sailors arrived in the 1600s, and it had a big hooked beak.

items.name: roadrunner
items.description: A fast-running desert bird of the American southwest that rarely flies
items.clue: A long-legged, crested ground-dweller of the southwestern US deserts that sprints after lizards and snakes.
items.alt: It's a speedy kind of cuckoo, and a cartoon coyote can never catch the one that says 'meep meep'.

items.name: snake
items.description: A long, legless, scaly reptile that slithers and hisses
items.clue: A long, legless creature that slithers on the ground and flicks its forked tongue.
items.alt: It sheds its skin in one piece, swallows prey whole, and some kinds are venomous.

items.name: cobra
items.description: A venomous snake that rears up and spreads a hood
items.clue: A venomous serpent that spreads a wide hood around its neck when threatened.
items.alt: Snake charmers in India play flutes to it in baskets, and some kinds can spit venom into an enemy's eyes.

items.name: rattlesnake
items.description: A venomous snake of American deserts that shakes a rattling tail
items.clue: A venomous desert serpent that shakes a buzzing tail tip as a warning.
items.alt: It has a triangle-shaped head and heat-sensing pits and lives in rocky places in the American West.

items.name: python
items.description: A huge non-venomous snake that squeezes prey to death by constriction
items.clue: A huge nonvenomous serpent that squeezes its prey to death and swallows it whole.
items.alt: It's one of the longest snakes in the world, comes from Asia and Africa, and is now an invasive problem in Florida swamps.

items.name: crocodile
items.description: A large river reptile with a narrow V-shaped snout and visible teeth
items.clue: A huge armored river predator with a long, pointed, V-shaped snout and teeth showing even when its mouth is closed.
items.alt: It lives in Africa, Asia and Australia, can survive in salt water, and is said to shed fake tears.

items.name: alligator
items.description: A large American swamp reptile with a broad U-shaped snout
items.clue: A large, dark river predator from the southeastern US with a broad, rounded U-shaped snout.
items.alt: It lurks in Florida swamps and Louisiana bayous, and its upper teeth are hidden when its mouth is closed.

items.name: turtle
items.description: A reptile with a hard shell that lives in ponds and swims
items.clue: A slow creature with a hard shell that pulls its head inside, often sunning itself on pond logs.
items.alt: It lays eggs in sand, some kinds snap, and four cartoon ones are pizza-loving ninja crime fighters.

items.name: tortoise
items.description: A slow land reptile with a high domed shell and elephant-like legs
items.clue: A slow land creature with a high domed shell and stumpy, elephant-like legs that can live over 100 years.
items.alt: In a famous fable it beats a hare in a race, and giant ones live on the Galapagos Islands.

items.name: sea turtle
items.description: A large ocean turtle with flippers that lays eggs on beaches
items.clue: A big shelled ocean swimmer with flippers that crawls up beaches to lay its eggs.
items.alt: Its hatchlings scramble toward the waves by moonlight, and it is often harmed by plastic bags it mistakes for jellyfish.

items.name: lizard
items.description: A small scaly reptile with four legs and a long tail that basks
items.clue: A small scaly creature with four legs and a long tail that basks on sunny rocks.
items.alt: It can drop its tail to escape a predator and grow a new one, and it darts quickly across walls.

items.name: chameleon
items.description: A lizard that changes colour, with swivelling eyes and a long sticky tongue
items.clue: A creature that changes the color of its skin and has eyes that move in different directions.
items.alt: It catches insects with a super-long sticky tongue, has a curly tail, and grips branches with tong-like feet.

items.name: iguana
items.description: A large green lizard with spines along its back and a dewlap
items.clue: A big green scaly creature with a row of spines down its back and a flap of skin under its chin.
items.alt: It lives in trees in Central and South America, eats leaves, and is a popular large pet lizard.

items.name: gecko
items.description: A small lizard with sticky toe pads that climbs walls and chirps
items.clue: A small lizard that can walk up walls and across ceilings with its sticky toes.
items.alt: It licks its own eyeballs to clean them, chirps at night, and sells car insurance in TV ads.

items.name: komodo dragon
items.description: The largest lizard, a giant venomous monitor from Indonesian islands
items.clue: The world's largest lizard, a huge monitor from Indonesia with a deadly, toxic bite.
items.alt: It can weigh as much as a person, flicks a forked yellow tongue, and hunts deer and water buffalo on a few islands.

items.name: frog
items.description: A smooth, slimy green amphibian that jumps and croaks, starting as a tadpole
items.clue: A small green hopper with long legs that croaks and catches insects with its tongue.
items.alt: It starts life as a tadpole, has smooth moist skin, and in fairy tales a princess kisses one to make a prince.

items.name: toad
items.description: A dry, warty brown amphibian that hops and lives mostly on land
items.clue: A bumpy, dry-skinned hopper that lives in gardens and is said to give you warts.
items.alt: It's brown and squat, has poison glands behind its eyes, and walks more than it leaps.

items.name: salamander
items.description: A smooth, moist-skinned amphibian with a lizard-like body and tail
items.clue: A small, smooth-skinned creature that looks like a lizard but lives in damp places under logs.
items.alt: It can regrow lost legs, has moist skin, and was once believed to be born from fire.

items.name: axolotl
items.description: A pink Mexican salamander with feathery external gills that stays aquatic
items.clue: A pink, smiley-faced creature with feathery gills that never grows up and stays in the water its whole life.
items.alt: It comes from lakes near Mexico City and can regrow its legs and even parts of its brain.

items.name: dinosaur
items.description: An extinct giant prehistoric reptile known from fossils, like T. rex
items.clue: A prehistoric giant that ruled the Earth millions of years ago before an asteroid wiped it out.
items.alt: Its fossil bones fill museums, and famous kinds include the T. rex and the three-horned triceratops.

items.name: dragon
items.description: A mythical giant winged reptile that breathes fire
items.clue: A mythical winged, scaly monster that breathes fire and guards piles of gold.
items.alt: A legendary beast that knights fight to rescue princesses, and in Chinese New Year parades it dances on poles.

items.name: ant
items.description: A tiny social insect living in colonies that carries crumbs
items.clue: A tiny creature that lives in a colony with a queen and carries crumbs many times its own weight.
items.alt: It marches in long lines to picnics, builds little hills of dirt, and some kinds bite or sting.

items.name: bee
items.description: A fuzzy yellow-and-black flying insect that makes honey and stings
items.clue: A buzzing yellow-and-black flier that makes honey and can sting.
items.alt: It lives in a hive, pollinates flowers, and does a waggle dance to tell the others where food is.

items.name: butterfly
items.description: An insect with large, colourful wings that flutters among flowers by day
items.clue: A colorful flier with large patterned wings that sips nectar from flowers.
items.alt: It starts out as a caterpillar, wraps itself in a chrysalis, and comes out completely transformed.

items.name: ladybug
items.description: A small round red beetle with black spots
items.clue: A tiny round red beetle with black spots.
items.alt: Gardeners love it because it eats aphids, and kids count its dots to guess its age.

items.name: spider
items.description: An eight-legged arachnid that spins silk webs to catch insects
items.clue: A creepy-crawly with eight legs that spins a sticky web to catch flies.
items.alt: It has eight eyes, bites its prey with fangs, and makes silk from glands at its rear end.

items.name: tarantula
items.description: A very large, hairy spider, sometimes kept as a pet
items.clue: A huge, hairy, eight-legged creature that hunts at night in deserts and rainforests.
items.alt: It flicks itchy hairs at enemies, can live for 25 years, and is kept as an exotic pet in a glass tank.

items.name: mosquito
items.description: A tiny buzzing insect that bites and sucks blood, leaving itchy bumps
items.clue: A tiny buzzing pest that bites you and sucks your blood, leaving itchy bumps.
items.alt: It breeds in standing water, spreads malaria, and whines around your ear at night.

items.name: fly
items.description: A common buzzing housefly with big compound eyes that lands on food
items.clue: A small buzzing pest that lands on food and is hard to swat.
items.alt: It has huge compound eyes, tastes with its feet, and its babies are maggots.

items.name: grasshopper
items.description: A green jumping insect with long hind legs that eats grass in fields
items.clue: A green jumper with powerful back legs that leaps through meadows.
items.alt: It makes a chirping sound by rubbing its legs on its wings, and swarms of one kind become locusts.

items.name: cricket
items.description: A dark jumping insect that chirps at night by rubbing its wings
items.clue: A small brown jumper that chirps loudly on summer nights.
items.alt: It rubs its wings together to make noise, counting its chirps tells the temperature, and pet stores sell it as lizard food.

items.name: beetle
items.description: An insect with hard shiny wing covers like an armoured shell
items.clue: A hard-shelled crawler whose front wings form a tough, shiny cover.
items.alt: There are more kinds of it than of any other creature, from stag to dung-rolling kinds, and a famous car is named after it.

items.name: cockroach
items.description: A brown, flat, fast-running pest insect that hides in kitchens
items.clue: A brown, fast-running household pest that scurries away when the lights turn on.
items.alt: It can survive almost anything, even living a week without its head, and hides in kitchens and sewers.

items.name: dragonfly
items.description: A long-bodied insect with four clear wings that darts over ponds
items.clue: A long, slender flier with four clear wings that darts over ponds.
items.alt: It has huge eyes covering most of its head, catches mosquitoes in midair, and its young live underwater.

items.name: firefly
items.description: A beetle whose glowing tail lights up summer nights
items.clue: A small flier whose tail glows and blinks on summer nights.
items.alt: Kids catch it in jars at dusk, and its light is made by a chemical reaction in its belly.

items.name: caterpillar
items.description: A soft, wormlike butterfly larva with many legs that eats leaves
items.clue: A fuzzy or striped crawler that munches leaves and later turns into a butterfly.
items.alt: It has many stubby legs, spins a cocoon or chrysalis, and in a classic picture book it is very hungry.

items.name: moth
items.description: A dull-coloured, fuzzy winged insect that flies at night toward lights
items.clue: A dusty-winged night flier that is drawn to porch lights.
items.alt: Its larvae eat holes in wool sweaters, and it rests with its wings spread flat.

items.name: wasp
items.description: A slim, yellow-and-black stinging insect with a narrow waist
items.clue: A thin-waisted yellow-and-black stinger that builds papery nests under roofs.
items.alt: It can sting many times, crashes picnics for soda and meat, and is a cousin of the hornet.

items.name: termite
items.description: A pale, antlike insect that eats wood and builds mounds
items.clue: A tiny pale crawler that eats wood and can destroy houses.
items.alt: It lives in colonies with a king and a queen and builds giant mud mounds in Africa.

items.name: praying mantis
items.description: A green insect that holds its front legs folded as if praying
items.clue: A green hunter that holds its spiky front legs folded together like hands in church.
items.alt: It can turn its triangular head to look over its shoulder, ambushes flies, and the female sometimes eats the male.

items.name: scorpion
items.description: An arachnid with pincers and a curled tail with a venomous stinger
items.clue: A desert crawler with pincers and a curled tail ending in a venomous stinger.
items.alt: It glows under ultraviolet light, has eight legs, and the mother carries her babies on her back.

items.name: flea
items.description: A tiny, wingless, jumping insect that bites pets and sucks blood
items.clue: A tiny jumper that lives in the fur of dogs and cats and bites them.
items.alt: It can leap over 100 times its body length, spread the plague, and old circuses featured it in tiny acts.

items.name: tick
items.description: A tiny eight-legged arachnid that latches onto skin and swells with blood
items.clue: A tiny eight-legged bloodsucker that latches onto your skin in tall grass and swells up.
items.alt: It can spread Lyme disease, hides on deer, and you should pull it off carefully with tweezers.

items.name: worm
items.description: A long, soft, legless earthworm that wriggles through soil
items.clue: A long, squishy, legless crawler that lives in soil and comes out when it rains.
items.alt: Robins pull it from lawns, anglers put it on hooks as bait, and its pink body is made of ring-like segments.

items.name: snail
items.description: A slow, slimy creature carrying a spiral shell on its back
items.clue: A slow, slimy crawler that carries a spiral shell on its back.
items.alt: It leaves a silvery trail, has eyes on stalks, and is eaten as escargot in France.

items.name: slug
items.description: A slimy, shell-less snail that leaves a mucus trail in gardens
items.clue: A slimy, shell-less crawler that comes out on damp nights to eat garden plants.
items.alt: It leaves a shiny trail, has two pairs of feelers, and gardeners set out beer traps to catch it.

items.name: centipede
items.description: A long, flat, segmented creepy-crawly with many legs and venomous bite
items.clue: A long, flat crawler with many legs, one pair per body segment, that scurries fast.
items.alt: Its name means 'hundred feet'; it has venomous front claws and hunts other creepy-crawlies in damp basements.

items.name: cicada
items.description: A large insect that buzzes loudly in summer trees, emerging after years underground
items.clue: A large, noisy summer flier whose males buzz loudly from the trees.
items.alt: Some kinds live underground for 17 years before emerging in huge numbers and leaving empty shells stuck to tree bark.

categories.label: vegetable
categories.description: A plant, fruit, vegetable or something made from plants

groups.label: fruit
groups.description: A sweet or tart fleshy part of a plant that holds its seeds and is usually eaten raw, such as berries, citrus, melons and orchard or tropical produce.

groups.label: vegetable to eat
groups.description: A savoury plant part cooked or eaten in meals, such as a root, tuber, leaf, stalk, bulb, pod or squash.

groups.label: nut, grain or bean
groups.description: A dry, hard edible seed or kernel, such as a tree nut, a cereal crop like rice or wheat, or a legume like lentils.

groups.label: herb or spice
groups.description: A leaf, seed, bark, bud or root used in small amounts to flavour or scent cooking.

groups.label: tree
groups.description: A large, long-lived woody plant with a trunk, branches and leaves or needles.

groups.label: flower
groups.description: A plant grown, picked or admired for its colourful, often fragrant blooms.

groups.label: other plant
groups.description: Any other living plant or plant part, such as grass, moss, ferns, cacti, seaweed, mushrooms, vines, leaves and cones.

groups.label: food made from plants
groups.description: A prepared or processed thing to eat made mainly from plants, such as bread, snacks, spreads, sauces and sweets.

groups.label: drink made from plants
groups.description: A beverage made mainly from plants, such as juice, tea, coffee, wine, beer or a dairy-free milk.

groups.label: material made from plants
groups.description: A non-edible material or everyday object made mainly from plants, such as wood, paper, cotton cloth, rope or rubber.

items.name: apple
items.description: A crisp round tree fruit, red or green, with white flesh and core
items.clue: Round and crunchy with red, green or yellow skin; one a day supposedly keeps the doctor away.
items.alt: Grows in orchards, ripens in autumn and gets pressed into cider or baked into pies; it has a core with small brown seeds.

items.name: banana
items.description: A long curved yellow fruit you peel, with soft sweet starchy flesh
items.clue: Long, curved and yellow; you peel back the skin to eat the soft, sweet inside.
items.alt: Grows in big hanging bunches in the tropics, gets brown spots as it ripens, and monkeys are famous for loving it.

items.name: orange
items.description: A round orange citrus fruit with thick peel and sweet juicy segments
items.clue: A round citrus with a thick, dimpled peel that you remove to get at the juicy segments inside.
items.alt: Squeezed for a popular breakfast juice and packed with vitamin C; you pull it apart into wedges.

items.name: strawberry
items.description: A small red heart-shaped berry with tiny seeds on its outside
items.clue: Small, red and heart-shaped, with tiny yellow seeds dotted on the outside and a green leafy cap.
items.alt: Picked in early summer from low-growing plants, it's often dipped in chocolate or served with cream.

items.name: grape
items.description: A small round juicy berry, green or purple, growing in vine bunches
items.clue: Small, round, juicy balls that grow in clusters on vines, in green, red or purple.
items.alt: Crushed and fermented to make wine; dried in the sun, it shrivels into a chewy snack.

items.name: watermelon
items.description: A large green melon with sweet, juicy red flesh and black seeds
items.clue: Huge and heavy with a striped green rind and juicy pink-red flesh full of black seeds.
items.alt: A classic summer picnic treat cut into big wedges; it's very refreshing and you can spit the seeds.

items.name: lemon
items.description: A bright yellow, oval, very sour citrus fruit used for juice
items.clue: Bright yellow, oval and very sour; you squeeze it over fish or into tea.
items.alt: A citrus so tart that biting into it makes your face pucker; its grated zest flavours cakes.

items.name: lime
items.description: A small green, sour citrus fruit, smaller than a lemon
items.clue: A small, round, green citrus that tastes sour; squeezed into margaritas and over tacos.
items.alt: Sailors once ate it to prevent scurvy; its tart green juice goes into salsa and many cocktails.

items.name: cherry
items.description: A small round dark red stone fruit on a long stem
items.clue: Small, round and dark red, often growing in pairs on long stems, with a hard pit inside.
items.alt: Placed on top of an ice-cream sundae; the trees it grows on are famous for pink spring blossoms.

items.name: pineapple
items.description: A large tropical fruit with spiky rough skin, leafy crown, sweet yellow flesh
items.clue: Tropical, with spiky, rough golden-brown skin and a crown of stiff green leaves on top.
items.alt: Its sweet, tangy yellow flesh is a controversial pizza topping and contains an enzyme that makes your tongue tingle.

items.name: peach
items.description: A round fuzzy-skinned orange-pink stone fruit with sweet juicy flesh
items.clue: Round with soft fuzzy skin, sweet juicy yellow-orange flesh and a large pit.
items.alt: Baked into cobbler or canned in syrup; it bruises easily and has a wrinkled stone in the middle.

items.name: pear
items.description: A sweet green or yellow tree fruit, narrow at top, wide at bottom
items.clue: Shaped like a bell, wide at the bottom and narrow at the top, with green or yellow skin.
items.alt: Sweet and slightly gritty in texture when ripe; it grows on orchard trees and is often poached in wine.

items.name: mango
items.description: An oval tropical stone fruit with sweet orange flesh and a flat pit
items.clue: Tropical, with smooth green, red and yellow skin, sweet bright orange flesh and one big flat stone.
items.alt: Hugely popular in India, its juicy flesh goes into lassis, chutneys and smoothies.

items.name: blueberry
items.description: A tiny round dark blue berry growing on bushes, eaten by handfuls
items.clue: Tiny, round and deep indigo-purple with a dusty bloom on the skin; baked into muffins and pancakes.
items.alt: Grows on low bushes in acidic soil and is often called a superfood full of antioxidants.

items.name: raspberry
items.description: A soft red berry made of tiny bumps, hollow in the middle
items.clue: Small, soft and red, made of many tiny juicy bumps, and hollow inside once pulled off its stem.
items.alt: Grows on thorny canes, and shares its name with the rude noise you make by blowing with your tongue out.

items.name: kiwi
items.description: A small brown fuzzy fruit with bright green flesh and tiny black seeds
items.clue: Small and oval with fuzzy brown skin and bright green flesh dotted with tiny black seeds.
items.alt: Shares its name with a flightless bird; you can cut it in half and scoop it out with a spoon.

items.name: coconut
items.description: A large hard hairy brown palm nut with white flesh and water inside
items.clue: A large, hard, hairy brown shell with white flesh and a sweet liquid inside.
items.alt: Grows high up on tropical palms; its shredded flesh tops cakes and its creamy milk is used in curries.

items.name: plum
items.description: A smooth-skinned purple or red stone fruit; dried it becomes a prune
items.clue: Smooth, round and purple or red, with juicy flesh and a pit; dried, it becomes a prune.
items.alt: A summer stone-bearing treat whose name also describes a deep reddish-purple colour.

items.name: avocado
items.description: A pear-shaped fruit with bumpy dark green skin, creamy green flesh, big pit
items.clue: Pear-shaped with bumpy dark green skin, creamy pale green flesh and a big round pit.
items.alt: Mashed into dips or spread on toast; it's rich in healthy fats and turns brown quickly once cut.

items.name: pomegranate
items.description: A round red fruit packed with many juicy red seeds inside
items.clue: Round with a leathery red skin, packed inside with hundreds of juicy ruby-red seeds.
items.alt: Messy to open, its glistening seeds are called arils and stain clothes; its juice is tart and deep red.

items.name: cantaloupe
items.description: A round melon with netted beige rind and sweet orange flesh
items.clue: Round with a rough, net-patterned beige rind and sweet orange flesh.
items.alt: Served cubed on breakfast platters, it has a hollow, seedy centre and gives off a musky smell when ripe.

items.name: apricot
items.description: A small orange stone fruit, smaller than a peach, often eaten dried
items.clue: Small, golden-orange and slightly fuzzy, like a little peach, with a smooth stone inside.
items.alt: Often dried into chewy orange halves or made into jam; it ripens early in summer.

items.name: papaya
items.description: A long tropical fruit with orange flesh and many black seeds in its centre
items.clue: Large and oblong and tropical, with orange flesh and a hollow centre full of shiny black seeds.
items.alt: Its soft, musky flesh contains an enzyme used to tenderise meat, and green unripe ones are shredded into salads in Thailand.

items.name: cranberry
items.description: A small hard tart red berry grown in bogs, used in sauce
items.clue: Small, hard, very tart and red; made into a sauce served with roast turkey.
items.alt: Grown in bogs that are flooded at harvest so the crop floats to the surface; its juice is very sour.

items.name: fig
items.description: A soft pear-shaped purple fruit full of tiny seeds, often dried
items.clue: Soft, teardrop-shaped and purple or green, with a sweet pink inside full of tiny crunchy seeds.
items.alt: Its tree's large lobed leaves are famous from old paintings, and it's often dried or baked into chewy bar cookies.

items.name: grapefruit
items.description: A large round citrus fruit with pink or yellow, sour-bitter flesh
items.clue: A big citrus, larger than an orange, with pink or yellow flesh that's tangy and a bit bitter.
items.alt: A classic diet breakfast, cut in half and eaten with a serrated spoon; it can interfere with some medicines.

items.name: blackberry
items.description: A soft black bumpy berry growing on thorny bramble bushes
items.clue: Dark purple, almost inky, soft and made of many juicy little bumps, growing on thorny brambles.
items.alt: Picked wild from prickly hedgerows in late summer and baked into crumbles; also the name of an old phone brand.

items.name: olive
items.description: A small bitter green or black oily fruit, pressed for oil
items.clue: Small and oval, green or black, too bitter to eat raw, so it's cured in brine and often stuffed with pimento.
items.alt: Grown on gnarled Mediterranean trees and pressed for oil; a branch of it is a symbol of peace.

items.name: date
items.description: A sweet sticky brown fruit from the date palm, with a long pit
items.clue: Sticky, sweet, wrinkled and brown, with a long thin pit, grown on palms in the desert.
items.alt: Very sugary and chewy, often stuffed or blended into energy bars; it shares its name with a day on the calendar.

items.name: honeydew melon
items.description: A round melon with smooth pale rind and sweet light green flesh
items.clue: Smooth pale green or cream rind with sweet, pale green, juicy flesh inside.
items.alt: Heavy and round with a waxy skin; its mild, very sweet minty-green flesh is a staple of hotel buffets.

items.name: carrot
items.description: A long orange root vegetable, crunchy, eaten raw or cooked
items.clue: Long, thin and orange, it grows underground, and rabbits love to munch it.
items.alt: A crunchy root grated into cake or used as a snowman's nose; it's said to help you see in the dark.

items.name: potato
items.description: A starchy brown-skinned underground tuber, boiled, baked, mashed or fried
items.clue: A lumpy brown tuber dug up from the ground, then mashed, baked or boiled.
items.alt: Grows underground with 'eyes' that sprout; the source of hash browns and crisps.

items.name: tomato
items.description: A round red juicy fruit used as a vegetable in salads and sauces
items.clue: Round, red and juicy; sliced onto burgers and cooked down into pasta sauce.
items.alt: Starts green and ripens on the vine; botanists and cooks disagree about how to classify it, and it's the base of salsa.

items.name: broccoli
items.description: A green vegetable with a thick stalk and tree-like florets
items.clue: Green and looks like a little tree, with a thick stalk and bushy florets on top.
items.alt: A cruciferous green that kids often refuse; it's steamed and served with cheese sauce.

items.name: lettuce
items.description: A leafy green vegetable with crisp pale leaves, the base of salads
items.clue: Leafy and green, the base of most salads and the crunch in a burger.
items.alt: Comes in iceberg and romaine varieties; it's mostly water and wilts quickly.

items.name: onion
items.description: A round layered bulb with papery skin, sharp taste, makes eyes water
items.clue: A round bulb with papery skin and layers inside; cutting it makes you cry.
items.alt: Comes in yellow, red and white, gets caramelised or battered into rings, and an ogre once said he has layers like one.

items.name: corn
items.description: A tall grass crop with ears of yellow kernels on a cob
items.clue: Tall stalks bearing ears wrapped in husks and silk, with rows of yellow kernels.
items.alt: Eaten on the cob with butter; also called maize, it's ground into tortillas and grits.

items.name: pea
items.description: Small round green seeds that grow in a pod
items.clue: Small, round and green, growing in a pod; you shell them and they roll off your plate.
items.alt: A princess in a fairy tale could feel one under a pile of mattresses; it's often sold frozen mixed with diced carrots.

items.name: cucumber
items.description: A long green watery vegetable with cool crisp flesh, eaten raw or pickled
items.clue: Long and green, cool with watery flesh, sliced into salads or soaked in vinegar brine.
items.alt: Slices of it are put over your eyes at a spa; it grows on a climbing vine.

items.name: celery
items.description: A pale green vegetable with long crunchy stringy stalks
items.clue: Long, pale green, crunchy stalks with stringy fibres, eaten with dip.
items.alt: Watery and crunchy, it's a garnish in a Bloody Mary and part of the base of many soups with onion and carrot.

items.name: pumpkin
items.description: A large round orange squash with hard rind, carved at Halloween
items.clue: Large, round and orange with ribbed skin; carved with spooky faces in October.
items.alt: A winter squash baked into a spiced pie in autumn; in a fairy tale it turns into a coach.

items.name: cabbage
items.description: A large round dense head of tightly packed green or purple leaves
items.clue: A big, round, tightly packed head of green or purple leaves, shredded into coleslaw.
items.alt: Fermented to make sauerkraut and kimchi; it smells strongly when boiled.

items.name: spinach
items.description: A dark green leafy vegetable with soft tender leaves, often cooked
items.clue: Dark green leaves eaten raw or wilted; a cartoon sailor ate it from a can for strength.
items.alt: Packed with iron, it shrinks to almost nothing when cooked and goes into creamed sides and dips.

items.name: bell pepper
items.description: A large hollow sweet pepper, red, yellow or green, not spicy
items.clue: Crunchy, hollow and blocky, in green, red, yellow or orange; sweet, not hot.
items.alt: Stuffed with rice and meat or sliced raw for dipping; it has a cluster of seeds attached to the stem inside.

items.name: garlic
items.description: A pungent white bulb made of small cloves, used for flavour
items.clue: A bulb made of small segments wrapped in papery white skin, with a strong pungent smell.
items.alt: Said to keep vampires away; it gives you strong breath and is crushed into many sauces.

items.name: cauliflower
items.description: A vegetable with a dense white head of florets and green leaves
